snippet.title: Dome RPG Introduction Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the world of Dome RPG! 
Follow Taro, a silent boy who once woke up in this world through his quest to salvage the world! 

Now available to wishlist on Steam!

Clownfair theme by Anton M. Corazza!

Lo-Fi Sunset theme by Joel4Audio!
